about: X8: the bundled program_checks.py on checks-sinumerik.MPF with its form defaults, no machine chosen. The whole report; every row with a line jumps to it.

report.title: Program checks

rows.message: G96: constant surface speed with no spindle speed clamp before it; the spindle speeds up as the diameter shrinks
G33 Z-30 K1.5 SF=0: a thread cut under constant surface speed; the speed changes with the diameter and the lead may not follow
G1 Z2 F0.1: a cut after G332 (left on line 25) with no new S; leaving G332 sets the spindle speed to zero
S1200 S1500 M3: 2 S words in one block
T="ROUGH" D1: a tool change while the modal call of CYCLE83 (line 31) is in force
G75: the control refuses it while radius compensation is on (G42, line 35)
G291: from here the control reads the program in its ISO dialect; these checks read it as written for this profile
G1 X60 F0.2: a cut while the spindle is stopped (M5 on line 42)
GOTOF NOWHERE: no block NOWHERE in this program
g0, x200: written in lower case; this control reads its addresses in upper case
–: – (en dash) is not an ASCII character, outside a comment
M30: the modal call of CYCLE83 (line 31) is still in force at the end of the program
G0 X200: after the program end M30 on line 54; it never runs

report.message: 16 findings in 15 checks. No machine chosen.
